title: Tumor-infiltrating immune cell types predicting recurrence-free survival in melanoma patients receiving adjuvant PD-1 inhibitor therapy.
snippet: Adjuvant treatment of melanoma patients with PD-1-based immunotherapy has improved recurrence rate, and became a standard treatment. title: Thyroid hormone sensitivity, insulin resistance and visceral fat area as determinants of prevalent coronary heart disease in euthyroid patients with type 2 diabetes.
snippet: Coronary heart disease (CHD) remains a leading cause of morbidity and mortality in patients with type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM).
